quiet_benchmark.interpretation: The measured delta is not material. Per-call QEMU plugin register and virtual-memory API overhead consumes the benefit of skipping the guest block.

conclusion: The reconstructed inner block is correct under sustained execution, but a QEMU plugin is not a useful acceleration transport. Runtime mode remains opt-in and disabled by default.
